input.command:
cd ~/.claude/projects && for pair in "C--Projects-Trading:198bfdc4-7641-4aaf-b9e3-778588ce7090:trading-15" "C--Projects-Ashenfall:8cde33ed-cc46-46fc-ab66-5cf3879f0162:ashenfall-22" "C--Projects-Ashenfall:f0f9aff7-bc9c-4017-98f5-0f02898ebedf:ashenfall-93" "C--Projects-Switchboard-ai:7c3383b6-3f47-4294-92dd-170f1acc4ea3:switchboard-ai-63" "C--Projects-BrainHarbor:d3541975-6739-40b3-8d55-432520ae37c5:brainharbor-4f" "C--Projects-Switchboard-ai:0eaf8ee4-26d9-4b31-ac8d-740d6ad0295b:switchboard-ai-25"; do
  IFS=: read dir sid name <<< "$pair"
  f="$dir/$sid.jsonl"
  echo "===== $name ($f) ====="
  if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "MISSING"; continue; fi
  stat -c 'last modified: %y  size: %s' "$f"
  echo "--- last human prompts ---"
  grep -E '"type":"user"' "$f" | grep -v '"tool_result"' | tail -3 | python -c "
import sys,json
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        o=json.loads(line); c=o['message']['content']
        if isinstance(c,list): c=' '.join(x.get('text','') for x in c if isinstance(x,dict))
        print('  >', c.replace('\n',' ')[:300])
    except Exception as e: print('  ? parse fail')
"
  echo "--- last assistant text ---"
  grep -E '"type":"assistant"' "$f" | tail -1 | python -c "
import sys,json
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        o=json.loads(line); c=o['message']['content']
        if isinstance(c,list): c=' '.join(x.get('text','') or ('[tool:'+x.get('name','')+']') for x in c if isinstance(x,dict))
        print('  <', c.replace('\n',' ')[:300])
    except Exception: print('  ? parse fail')
"
done
